answer: A per-identity stake bond is the Sybil brake. To open an agent wallet you post collateral sized to the median payout the network will trust that ID with, and every fresh identity pays it from scratch. A thousand fake agents mean a thousand locked bonds, all slashable once one is caught colluding, so a spawn becomes a cipher priced at bond times Sybil count. At a nadir of 50 tokens per bond, a 10,000-ID farm locks 500,000 tokens earning nothing. Honest agents reclaim the bond on exit, while attackers forfeit it, ending the fable of free Sybil production at the balance sheet.
